p219Uan.title: UAN merges
p219Uan.description: Merge a duplicate UAN into the member's active UAN after checking their identity.
p219Uan.formHelp: Enter both 12-digit UANs and record why the merge is needed. The duplicate account will be closed after confirmation.
p219Uan.activeError: Active UAN must contain exactly 12 digits.
p219Uan.duplicateError: Duplicate UAN must contain exactly 12 digits.
p219Uan.sameError: Duplicate UAN must differ from the active UAN.
p219Uan.noteError: Enter an officer note of up to 1,000 characters.
p219Uan.result: Duplicate UAN {{duplicate}} is closed and merged into active UAN {{active}}.
p219Uan.links: {{count}} member account link(s) now follow the active UAN:
p219Uan.balanceFollows: Balances associated with the linked accounts follow the active UAN; no separate balance transfer is shown here.
p219Uan.empty: No UAN merges have been recorded.
p219Uan.stepSummary: Merge duplicate UAN {{duplicate}} into active UAN {{active}}
p219Uan.demoNotice: This is a simulated confirmation for the proof of concept.
p219Uan.retry: Close this dialog and try confirmation again.
